symptom: Lookups of internal service names time out after the cluster DNS was moved behind a forwarder.

evidence.deploy_change: Cluster DNS moved behind a forwarder; client resolver timeout unchanged
notes: Resolver latency, timeout and retries are captured settings, recreated on a UDP stub on loopback.
The stub answers late from the fifth query on; it is selected, not a sample of real resolver behaviour.
Names resolved before the degradation are the ones a cache could have served.
